sloka: ये च त्वां घोरचक्षुर्भिः पश्यन्ति प्राणिनो भुवि ।हतास्ते यमदण्डेन सद्यो निरयगामिनः ।। ७.८२.११ ॥
transliteration: ye ca tvāṁ ghoracakṣurbhiḥ paśyanti prāṇino bhuvi ।hatāste yamadaṇḍena sadyo nirayagāminaḥ ।। 7.82.11 ॥

translations.english: Those living beings on earth who look at you with hostile eyes are immediately struck down by the rod of Yama and go to hell.
